name: BA-55
author: swtdr34mz
tagline: A bassline after the Erica Synths DB-01, with only what the DB-01 has: one VCO, sub, noise, BBD detune, overdrive, a Polivoks-style LP/BP filter, and its 64-step sequencer
description: A monophonic bassline after the Erica Synths Bassline DB-01, with only its own controls: one VCO (triangle, saw, square), sub, noise, BBD-style detune, overdrive, FM from the LFO, a saturating 12 dB Polivoks-style LP/BP filter with decay and depth, a sustain-release VCA (fully up: a drone), an LFO with 10 shapes. The DB-01 sequencer: 64 steps with gate, accent, slide, mod track, pitch envelope and probability per step, play modes, shuffle, random patterns with limits, scales and an arpeggiator. 16 presets, MIDI clock in. Unofficial.
credits: Built on fm1-base (Charles Vestal) and felucca-bsp (Leo Kuroshita, Hügelton Instruments).
